description: Na₁₅Y₂C₉SO₃₀ClF crystallizes in the trigonal P3 space group. There are seven inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form edge-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. There are three shorter (2.37 Å) and three longer (2.46 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form edge-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. There are three shorter (2.31 Å) and three longer (2.47 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted edge-sharing NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids. There are three shorter (2.45 Å) and three longer (2.47 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five O and one F atom. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.79 Å. The Na-F bond length is 2.09 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O and one Cl atom. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.57 Å. The Na-Cl bond length is 3.09 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded to seven O atoms to form NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share edges with two NaO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.58 Å. In the seventh Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to one C, six O, and one Cl atom. The Na-C bond length is 2.76 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-3.00 Å. The Na-Cl bond length is 2.71 Å. There are two inequivalent Y sites. In the first Y site, Y is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Y-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.50 Å. In the second Y site, Y is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Y-O bond distances ranging from 2.46-2.48 Å. There are three inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.28-1.32 Å. In the second C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.28-1.32 Å. In the third C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.28 Å) and one longer (1.33 Å) C-O bond length. S is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All S-O bond lengths are 1.49 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Na, two Y, and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Y, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Y, and one C atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one C atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to three Na and one C atom to form distorted ONa₃C trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₃YC trigonal bipyramid and corners with two equivalent ONa₃C trigonal pyramids. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one C atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one C atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Y, and one C atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃YC trigonal bipyramids. In the tenth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Y, and one C atom to form distorted ONa₃YC trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃YC trigonal bipyramids,  a cornercorner with one ONa₃C trigonal pyramid, and edges with three ONa₃YC trigonal bipyramids. Cl is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six Na atoms. F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent Na atoms.
